title: Reproducibility package for: A developmental transcriptomic hierarchy links human cortical maturation to adult cortical phenotypes and autism-associated anatomy
description: Manuscript-facing reproducibility package for the Developmental Transcriptomic Hierarchy (DTHI) study. The archive contains derived manuscript source data, Supplementary Tables S1-S15, final Figures 1-6 and figure source data, manuscript-relevant analysis and figure-generation code, prospective validation lock and audit materials, final gate closure outputs, software/environment information and provenance hashes. Raw third-party datasets are not redistributed. At prospective closure, 0/7 prespecified gates passed and no strict convergent regulator was established.
